Riya (CSM): CascadeTech dedicated bring-up Friday 09:00 PST. Targets: steady 600 RPS, short business spikes to 2k for 30s. Need final quotas, autoscale, priming plan, and a short ops handoff. Renewal in 7 months; onboarding flagged for health watch.

Ben (SRE): Copy. Contracted reserved_gpus=10, burst policy +15% if spare. I'll set a 24h slot-lock and soft-throttle at 80% GPU mem. Share token profile please.

Kofi (Infra): Sample: p50=68, p95=230, avg request ~340 tokens. Recommend slot_max_seq=512, min_slots=4, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s. Add automatic fallback to quantized-small if tail latency >550ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Avoid KMS rotation during warmup.

Mina (Solutions): Load plan: smoke 10m @100RPS, soak 2h @600RPS, spike script: 20s ramp ->2k, hold 30s, decay 40s. We'll run loadgen and capture token-level latency + KV hit rates. Command (test creds):

./loadgen --url https://dedicated-us.redwood/api/generate --concurrency 200 --qps 600 --burst 2000 --burst-duration 30 --duration 7200 --header 'x-customer-id:CASCADE'

Kofi (Infra): Pre-warm KV cache with priming job ~30m before window. Example:

python prime.py --endpoint /prime --slots 8 --concurrency 40 --duration 1800 --prefix-dir ./samples

Riya (CSM): Action items: @Kofi apply autoscale + priming (EOD); @Ben set throttle & slot lock (AM); @Mina run smoke & soak. I'll host the 09:00 PST call and include billing + renewals. ops-bot please set reminder.

ops-bot: reminder set: "CascadeTech dedicated warmup" 2024-04-19T16:00:00Z (Fri 09:00 PST). Post-run summary will be auto-attached to this thread. :white_check_mark:

Ben (SRE): I'll also add a short escalation snippet to the invite: alert thresholds, pager contacts, and quick mitigation steps.

Riya (CSM): Thanks all. If we hit >2 throttles during onboarding we escalate to renewals and open an account health review. Keep replies short.
